svg.title: Where Kodi gets its media
svg.desc: Three ways media reaches Kodi on the Pi 5. A: Kodi reads the NAS share over SMB or NFS and builds its own library. B: Jellyfin, running in Docker on the Pi 5, reads the same NAS files and Kodi connects to it with the Jellyfin for Kodi or JellyCon add-on; Jellyfin also serves phones, laptops and other TVs. C: streaming add-ons from the official Kodi repository bring in online services. Warning: pick A or B as your main library, not both, or every movie shows up twice.

g.text: Use A or B for your own library, not both:
otherwise every movie shows up twice.
